comment: Upstream curl builds Surl may be measured against, pinned by SHA-256. Anything else is refused (ADR-0003). Pinning another build is a decision; never pin the Curl port. Each build's role is 'reference' (the release named below, used for every measurement unless a case needs what it lacks; a build with no role is a reference build) or 'supplementary' (pinned only for the protocols and features its ADR names, never to second-guess a reference build; ADR-0017).

builds.origin: Git for Windows, mingw64 build of upstream curl, Schannel
builds.version: curl 8.21.0 (x86_64-w64-mingw32) libcurl/8.21.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.2 brotli/1.2.0 zstd/1.5.7 libidn2/2.3.8 libpsl/0.21.5 libssh2/1.11.1 WinLDAP
builds.protocols: dict file ftp ftps gopher gophers http https imap imaps ipfs ipns ldap ldaps mqtt mqtts pop3 pop3s rtsp scp sftp smtp smtps telnet tftp ws wss
builds.features: alt-svc AsynchDNS brotli HSTS HTTPS-proxy IDN IPv6 Kerberos Largefile libz NTLM PSL SPNEGO SSL SSPI threadsafe UnixSockets zstd
